offering_description.value: Dycom designs, builds and maintains fiber, cable and wireless networks for telecommunications providers. Its crews also install electrical systems for data centers and provide underground utility locating, construction and maintenance for utilities.

primary_services.value: telecom network engineering and program management; wired and wireless network construction and maintenance; data center electrical contracting; underground utility locating; electric and gas utility construction and maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: Telecom carriers, broadband and cable operators, data center developers and operators, and electric and gas utilities

end_markets.value: telecommunications and broadband; data centers; electric utilities; natural gas utilities

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Project and master service agreements for network engineering, construction, maintenance, utility locating and data center electrical installations

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses engineering teams, field crews and equipment to build and maintain infrastructure for telecom, data center and utility customers

geography_served.value: US national: Nationwide telecom contracting, with data center electrical work concentrated in the Mid-Atlantic

specialization.value: related lines: Telecom network contracting, data center electrical installations, utility locating and utility construction

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Master service agreements and project bids for telecom providers, data center customers and utilities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: OSHA construction and electrical safety standards, state underground utility protection rules and local construction and right-of-way permits
